title: refactor(console): re-key the API Console storage catalog to the canonical `storage` slot
body:
Fixes #5291

Clause-②: no — a console-internal catalog is re-keyed to the spec's canonical slot name. No library export, schema or accept set moves.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM loop, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (os-dev, `mode:subagent`).

## What changed

- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts`: the Storage entry of `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG` is keyed `storage`, the canonical `CoreServiceName` slot, and no longer the deprecated `file-storage`. `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` and the special-cased lookup in `discover()` are removed. The lookup is `discoveredServices[serviceName]` again, so the page reads the canonical key and nothing else.
- `useApiDiscovery.test.ts`:
  - The tripwire now pins `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG.storage` as defined, `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG['file-storage']` as undefined, and `storage` as a `CoreServiceName` member.
  - The alias-table case is deleted.
  - The deprecated-alias case is inverted: a `file-storage` row alone renders no group.
  - Two cases are added. The v17 mirror shape (both keys, byte-equal) renders one Storage group. `routes.storage` is used when the service row carries no `route`.
  - The fail-closed cases are re-keyed to `storage`.
- `.changeset/5291-api-console-storage-slot.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch.

## Premise check (base `cdefa2a06`, the `origin/main` this branch was cut from)

- **H1 (restart condition), held.** The card's own probe exits 0 from the worktree root and from `apps/console`:
  - probe: `node -e "process.exit(require('@objectstack/spec/system').CoreServiceName.options.includes('storage')?0:1)"`;
  - resolved package: `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`;
  - `CoreServiceName.options` lists both `storage` and `file-storage`;
  - on base the catalog was still keyed `'file-storage'` and the alias table was present.
- **H2 (what a 17.4.0 server announces): both keys.**
  - The installed spec's own `CHANGELOG.md` (entry `593c4bf`, under its 17.1.0 heading) says: "Discovery reports the service under the canonical `storage` key and mirrors the row verbatim under the `file-storage` key for the alias's v17 lifetime".
  - objectstack `origin/main` corroborates this in both producers. `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` builds the `storage` and `'file-storage'` entries from the same `svcAvailable(routes.storage, ...)` expression. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` assigns `services['file-storage'] = { ...services['storage'] }`.
  - So removing the alias drops the Storage group on no backend that carries this mirror. The one boundary is under Acceptance notes.
- **H3 (other readers): none.**
  - `git grep -n -E "file-storage|fileStorage|file_storage"` over the whole tree, excluding `CHANGELOG.md` files and the lockfile, hits only the two touched files.
  - Control, same channel: `git grep -c DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES -- apps packages` hits both files on base.
  - `useApiDiscovery` has one importer, `ApiConsolePage.tsx`, which uses only the hook.

## Verification

The final head is `b609d15dc`. The changeset commit on top of `3e11bd3cf` touches no code, so the touched test file has the same bytes at both commits.

**Red on base, green on head: the touched test file.**

- **Head:** `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.test.ts` printed `Tests  14 passed (14)`. The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Base leg:** the source file was replaced on disk by the base blob, and the new test file was kept.
  - The disk `git hash-object` equalled the base blob `0d878ff02`.
  - `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` went from 0 to 4 occurrences, and the canonical-key line `storage: {` went from 1 to 0.
  - vitest printed `Tests  3 failed | 11 passed (14)` and exited 1.
  - Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` on that path, with a trap. The disk blob then equalled the HEAD blob `18ed1d6c8`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

  The three cases that failed on base:
  - `does not read the deprecated file-storage alias`: "expected { key: 'Storage', ... } to be undefined".
  - `falls back to routes.storage when the service row advertises no route`: got `/api/v1/storage/...` instead of `/api/v2/files/...`. On base the `routes` map was indexed with `file-storage`, a key `ApiRoutesSchema` does not have.
  - `the storage group is keyed by the canonical slot, never by the deprecated alias`: "catalog must be keyed by the canonical storage slot: expected undefined to be defined".
- **Green on both, by design:**
  - The mirror-shape case is a control for the real producer shape.
  - `SLOTS.has('storage')` asserts the installed spec, not the source.
  - The fail-closed cases pass on both sides because base read the canonical key first.

**Package suite:** `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/` at `b609d15dc` printed `Test Files  116 passed (116)` and `Tests  1270 passed (1270)`. The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The 116 files equal the tracked test-file count under `apps/console`, which includes the touched one.

**Typecheck:**

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (both `tsc` legs) exited 0 with 0 `error TS`, and the lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `tsc --noEmit --listFilesOnly` in `apps/console` lists both touched files, among 3793 files in the program.

**Lint:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console exec eslint . --format json` covered 220 files with 0 errors. The warnings are pre-existing `no-explicit-any` / `set-state-in-effect`; the touched test file has 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pre-mirror backends.** A backend older than the framework#9683 discovery mirror reports this slot only as `file-storage`. Against such a backend the API Console now hides the Storage group, fail-closed like any slot absent from `/discovery`. Every backend that carries the mirror renders the same group as before. The card and its re-queue scope the retirement of the console-side alias to now, not staged. The changeset states this behaviour change.
- **Stale comments in objectstack.** Both objectstack mirror sites (`http-dispatcher.ts` and `protocol.ts`) have comments that name objectui's console endpoint catalog as a reader of the `file-storage` key. Once this lands, that is no longer true. This is comment drift with no behavioural consequence. Noted, not filed. Carrier: whoever retires the alias at the next major.
